input: Renew my passport before it expires

gold.taskTitle: Renew My Passport Before It Expires
gold.taskDescription: Renew the user's passport in time before the current one expires.

questions.title: When exactly does your current passport expire?
questions.description: Understand the expiration date to determine urgency and timeline.

questions.title: Which country issued your passport?
questions.description: Identify the issuing country to apply the correct renewal process and requirements.

questions.title: Do you have any upcoming travel that creates a hard deadline?
questions.description: Determine if there is a fixed travel date that makes the renewal time-sensitive.

questions.title: Is this a first-time renewal or have you renewed before?
questions.description: Assess familiarity with the renewal process to tailor guidance accordingly.

questions.title: Do you prefer to apply in person, by mail, or online?
questions.description: Identify the preferred or available application method for the renewal.

questions.title: Do you already have a passport photo ready?
questions.description: Check whether a compliant passport photo needs to be obtained as part of the plan.

questions.title: Are you willing to pay extra for expedited processing?
questions.description: Determine if budget allows for faster processing options in case of tight timelines.
